additional_verification_required: Additional verification is required to complete login. Complete the displayed verification step.
authentication_rate_limited: Too many authentication attempts. Wait before trying again.
authentication_unavailable: The authentication service could not complete the request. Retry later; contact an administrator if the problem continues.
captcha_invalid: The challenge is invalid or expired. Request a new challenge and try again.
captcha_unavailable: The challenge is temporarily unavailable. Retry later.
email_verification_request_rejected: The email verification request origin is not allowed. Use the configured application address or contact an administrator.
email_verification_unavailable: Email verification could not complete the request. Retry later; contact an administrator if the problem continues.
invalid_email_verification_credential: The email verification link is invalid, expired, or already used. Request a new verification link.
invalid_login: The login name or password is incorrect. Check the credentials or start password recovery.
invalid_mfa: The multi-factor authentication code is invalid. Wait for a new code and try again.
invalid_mfa_challenge: The multi-factor authentication challenge or code is invalid or expired. Restart sign-in and use a new code.
invalid_mfa_enrollment: The multi-factor authentication enrollment is invalid or expired. Restart enrollment.
invalid_passkey_challenge: The passkey challenge is invalid or expired. Restart the passkey operation.
invalid_passkey_credential: The passkey credential could not be verified. Retry with a registered passkey or use another sign-in method.
invalid_password: The current password is incorrect or the new password does not meet the security policy. Check the password and try again.
invalid_personal_token: The personal access token request is invalid. Check the token name, permissions and expiry, then try again.
invalid_phone_verification_code: That code is wrong or has expired. Request a new one.
invalid_recovery_credential: The password recovery link is invalid, expired, or already used. Request a new recovery link.
invalid_recovery_request: The password recovery request is invalid. Correct the request data and try again.
invalid_registration: The registration data is invalid. Enter a valid email address, a password of at least 12 characters, and a display name of at most 128 characters.
login_request_rejected: The login request origin is not allowed. Use the configured application address or contact an administrator.
mfa_already_enabled: Multi-factor authentication is already enabled for this account. Manage the existing factor instead.
mfa_not_enabled: Multi-factor authentication is not enabled for this account. Enable it before performing this operation.
passkey_attestation_rejected: The passkey attestation was rejected by the configured authenticator policy. Use an approved security key or contact an administrator.
passkey_limit_reached: The account has reached the registered passkey limit. Remove an unused passkey before adding another.
passkey_not_found: The requested passkey was not found. Refresh the passkey list and choose an existing passkey.
passkey_request_rejected: The passkey request origin is not allowed. Use the configured application address or contact an administrator.
passkey_unavailable: Passkey authentication could not complete the request. Retry later or use another configured sign-in method.
password_recovery_unavailable: Password recovery could not complete the request. Retry later; contact an administrator if the problem continues.
password_reused: The new password was used recently. Choose a different password.
phone_verification_unavailable: Phone verification is unavailable. Try again later; contact an administrator if the problem continues.
primary_email_required: This operation requires a verified primary email address. Add or verify the primary email first.
primary_phone_required: Add a phone number to your account before verifying it.
recovery_cooldown_active: A recovery request was sent recently. Wait before requesting another one.
recovery_request_rejected: The password recovery request origin is not allowed. Use the configured application address or contact an administrator.
registration_conflict: The registration request conflicts with the current account state. Sign in, recover the account, or contact an administrator.
registration_request_rejected: The registration request origin is not allowed. Use the configured application address or contact an administrator.
registration_unavailable: Self-service registration is not available. Contact an administrator for access or try again later.
return_url_not_allowed: The return URL is not allowlisted. Use an approved application address or contact an administrator.
session_not_found: The browser session was not found or is no longer active. Refresh the session list before trying again.
